item.title: Bridging AI, Automation, and Sustainability in Software Testing
item.content:encoded:
This special issue invites selected papers that explore the intersection of artificial intelligence, automation, and sustainability within the context of software testing. The collection aims to bring together research that advances testing methodologies through intelligent technologies while considering environmental and operational sustainability impacts.

Appel publié par Journal of Systems and Software. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • AI in software testing
  • Automation in software testing
  • Sustainability in software testing
